question: Which famous ex best friends just reunited at a wedding?
story: Kylie Jenner sat and clapped at Jordyn Woods' wedding, years after a scandal blew up their friendship in public. According to E! News, Sports Illustrated and the Mirror, Woods married Knicks star Karl-Anthony Towns on Saturday, August fifteenth, in Malibu. Black tie. Outdoors. The ceremony looked out over the Pacific. Woods wore a white strapless gown with a long veil, and the guest list read like a group chat you could never get into. Justin and Hailey Bieber. Michael B. Jordan. Ben Stiller. Half the Knicks roster. Here is the part everyone zoomed in on. Kylie Jenner was there, seated near the aisle with Timothee Chalamet, and photos reportedly show her applauding as the newlyweds walked back up it. The two were nearly inseparable before a twenty nineteen scandal ended things. Reports say they have been quietly repairing it since twenty twenty three. One wedding, and the most talked about friendship in Hollywood is officially back on.
